title: RefDecoder: Enhancing Visual Generation with Conditional Video Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2605.15196v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Video generation powers a vast array of downstream applications. However, while the de facto standard, i.e., latent diffusion models, typically employ heavily conditioned denoising networks, their decoders often remain unconditional. We observe that this architectural asymmetry leads to significant loss of detail and inconsistency relative to the input image. To address this, we argue that the decoder requires equal conditioning to preserve structural integrity. We introduce RefDecoder, a reference-conditioned video VAE decoder by injecting high-fidelity reference image signal directly into the decoding process via reference attention. Specifically, a lightweight image encoder maps the reference frame into the detail-rich high-dimensional tokens, which are co-processed with the denoised video latent tokens at each decoder up-sampling stage. translated_title: RefDecoder：通过条件视频解码增强视觉生成
translated_abstract: 视频生成驱动着大量下游应用。然而，作为事实上的标准，潜空间扩散模型通常采用高度条件化的去噪网络，但其解码器往往保持无条件状态。我们观察到这种架构上的不对称性会导致相对于输入图像的显著细节丢失和不一致性。为了解决这个问题，我们认为解码器需要同等的条件化以保持结构完整性。我们提出了RefDecoder，这是一种参考条件化的视频VAE解码器，通过参考注意力将高保真参考图像信号直接注入解码过程。具体而言，一个轻量级图像编码器将参考帧映射为细节丰富的高维标记，这些标记在每个解码器上采样阶段与去噪后的视频潜空间标记协同处理。我们在多个不同的解码器骨干网络上展示了一致的改进。
tldr: 提出RefDecoder，一种通过参考注意力将高保真参考图像信号注入视频VAE解码过程的参考条件化解码器，有效解决了潜空间扩散模型中解码器无条件化导致的细节丢失和结构不一致问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes RefDecoder, a reference-conditioned video VAE decoder that injects high-fidelity reference image signals into the decoding process via reference attention, effectively addressing the detail loss and inconsistency caused by unconditional decoders in latent diffusion models.
